content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

How many property sales were recorded in England and Wales in 2023? (counting all sales where the year is 2023)

content.statement:
SELECT *
FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID_SEMANTIC
    METRICS sales_count
    WHERE YEAR(uk_price_paid.date) = 2023
)
